prior_art_and_role: STAC's localized sharp blend; independent top-1; classical discrete labeling. Historical m03 also selects candidates over time, so spatial joint mode preservation needs explicit collision review.

inputs: qualified sparse target modes and normalized scores per anchor landmark
fixed anchor spatial graph and legal R_ij hints
identical output lift for every mode reduction
outputs: full original-identity mesh sequence at every original frame
unchanged faces and retained vertex mapping
solver residuals, input/source hashes and end-to-end costs

planned_math_to_code.statement: For two opposite rotation modes of a vector, their mean can have a smaller norm than either mode.
Choose labels k_i minimizing sum_i -log p_i,k_i + lambda sum_(i,j) ||(y_i,k_i-y_j,k_j)-R_ij(x_i-x_j)||^2.
The general discrete objective is nonconvex; beam/message/graph search is approximate and must retain its achieved objective and budget.
